notes.title: Fix Bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug where when changing the interface color the color of the score did not change

notes.title: Difficulties have been improved
notes.content: Difficulty increase progression has been changed

notes.title: Update Python and PyGame
notes.content:
- Update to Python 3.11.5
- Update to PyGame 2.5.2
- Fixed incorrect screen resolution for users with scaling

notes.title: Changing Difficulties
notes.content:
- Completely redesigned difficulty system, now the difficulty increases smoothly, while the initial difficulty decreased
- Improved performance by optimizing text rendering
- PyGame version was updated from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0
